title: Overbudget Haar-Purity Subsystem Designs Beyond the Quadratic Threshold
description: Extremal geometry of complex-Haar subsystem-purity fluctuations across arbitrary overbudget cut counts m > n via folded Johnson harmonic analysis, S(5,6,12)/Z_2 Delsarte LP duality, and Parseval asymptotic bounds, with zero-dependency exact integer and rational verification scripts.
